lenses.name: The Opening Map
lenses.visual_thesis: AI compresses routine tasks while expanding a visible opening around higher-value human work.
lenses.recurring_carrier: A role field that splits into task lanes, becomes a document surface and skills constellation, then curls into a human-AI loop and forward path.
beat_progression: Threat question holds over an intact role field
Role splits into tasks and the opening appears
Drafting example separates speed from purpose, judgment, and audience trust
Durable human skills connect above the AI current
Human question and AI draft combine in a review loop
Judgment, range, and tool fluency lead through openings
milestone_frames: The role is not the task
lenses.motion_logic: Blue elements accelerate and condense; gold elements open, connect, and gain space through continuous shape transformations.
lenses.primary_risk: The evolving map could feel abstract without concrete document and audience imagery.

lenses.name: Career Weather Radar
lenses.visual_thesis: AI is moving weather to navigate rather than a rival to defeat.
lenses.recurring_carrier: A radar sweep that identifies fast-changing task zones, stable human terrain, and navigable openings.
beat_progression: Anxiety appears as a storm front
Radar separates roles from changing tasks
A three-pass scan identifies automation, rising value, and position
A drafting signal is checked by human instruments
Human skills become stable navigation beacons
Human and AI inputs converge on a route
lenses.motion_logic: A rotating scan reveals or recolors zones while route vectors update toward the next stable beacon.
lenses.primary_risk: Weather metaphors may imply prediction or danger more strongly than the script supports.

selection_reason: The Opening Map makes the lesson's core causal claim visible: when AI compresses one task, human judgment and relationship work gain space and value. It supports the concrete drafting example and the practical four-step collaboration loop without adding a threat-heavy metaphor. Its carrier can evolve across every beat, so the lesson feels like one argument unfolding rather than a sequence of slides.
